proof_summary: For odd primes, the recurrence \(a(n+1)=(2^n-1)a(n)+2^{\binom{n+1}{2}}\) has both its coefficient and forcing term unchanged modulo \(p\) after shifting by \(2(p-1)\), by Fermat’s theorem; the base congruence follows because every nonfinal summand contains \(2^{2(p-1)}-1\), while the final summand is \(1\) modulo \(p\), so induction gives the result. For \(p=2\), the same recurrence shows inductively that every \(a(n)\) with \(n\ge1\) is odd.
